english.description: Every survivor deserves an Oscar. So it goes.
english.name: ALIVE

english.description: An immortal Chicken on a stick makes an excellent dielectric. We do not recommend trying this in real life, unless you have an immortal chicken and an immortal you.
english.name: CHICKENDIELECTRIC

english.description: The artist can offend and draw anyone. Usually, this happens simultaneously.
english.name: PAINTER

english.description: It's warm in underpants, and you can hibernate in winter if you have a whole lot of them!
english.name: SANDWICH

english.description: You can solve any case if you know for sure who you want to blame.
english.name: SHERLOCK

english.description: It's indecent to fart on Earth, but farting in space can save your life by giving your body acceleration at the last moment.
english.name: SMALLGASES

english.description: You are immune to criticism. You are simply THE best. Everything your hands get to touch and create is GENIUS. This achievement is unique and is meant to be given to no one but you. Everyone else has a fake copy of it.
english.name: BUILDER

english.description: Someone else's pass works just like someone else's diploma: it allows you to connect to engineering terminals and boast that you're a hacker while simply touching "Yes"/"No" on monitors.
english.name: ENGINEER

english.description: The ignition of natural gas can cause not only a heated argument on some online forum but also a 20% increase in the flight speed with accelerators.
english.name: FIREASS

english.description: When your life hangs in the balance, oxygen is left for one breath, the world is in danger, and death and suffering surround you — fly through all the rings!
english.name: AGILITY

english.description: When you jogged for three days in a row, prepared yourself mentally to serve in the army, boasted that you were going to be a paratrooper, and then suddenly failed all medical tests — can this be considered as "almost served", or not?
english.name: SURVE

english.description: The vacuum cleaner can not only help to clean the apartment quickly but can also rush through space and time like a jet motorbike. So convenient!
english.name: CLEANER

english.description: Labor turned ape into a... more muscular ape. You have unique destruction skills, now your delicate workmanship with the handy scrapper will cause more damage to everything you touch with it.
english.name: DESTROYER

english.description: "It's a bad thing to destroy the whole garbage collecting infrastructure for selfish purposes," so my mother says. Although who cares, anyway? Isn't that a cleaner robot in the distance?
english.name: DIRTY

english.description: The dead people flying around are highly unlikely to say "wow!" to your highly polished brand new ZAZ but it's still nice to enjoy the ride with the wind... Or without it...
english.name: DRIVER

english.description: If you mess around with electricity for a long time, you might get immune to it. Probably. But it's better not to try it.
english.name: ELECTRONIC

english.description: Completing the second chapter will be almost as difficult as completing the third one. That's how it is.
english.name: END2CHAPTER

english.description: Completing the third chapter will be almost as difficult as completing the second one. That's how it is.
english.name: END3CHAPTER

english.description: It would be an awful thing to open coffins if we weren't talking about their back panel containing the control panel. And since it's all about the control panel, then all is well, and you can proceed to open it.
english.name: HAKER

english.description: Congratulations! If you didn't cheat, then you are helping the industry to develop! In some way, not necessarily in the right one.
english.name: INDUSTRIALHELPER

english.description: Scanning the dead product of genetic engineering will help the spacesuit to replenish its library of useless images. And it might be possible to sell these pictures to the newspapers if need be.
english.name: MUTAGEN

english.description: It's very easy to determine a person's mental disorder by the color of his spacesuit. Especially if you're a charlatan. A real professional will try to find and add all the other possible signs of the illness.
english.name: PSYCHO

english.description: You are a rebel at heart, a rebel by nature, and a rebel by horoscope. Down with other people's advice! Stick your fingers in…
english.name: REBELIOUS

english.description: It may seem that making a hundred or two shots is not so difficult, but when each shot is worth the cost of a whole space station, it's a completely different story.
english.name: RIFLEMAN

english.description: Attacking a security robot is a felony, even if no one saw you do it. On the other hand, it is still a felony, so there is nothing good about it.
english.name: ROUGE

english.description: It's really easy to herd cows in space: just pile them up in a heap and don't touch them until the rescuers come.
english.name: SHEPHERD

english.description: There's no point in heroically covering a barrel of a beam weapon with your chest. You can, if you like, but in this case, it's just not necessary. If you really want to do it, don't forget to turn the weapon off first.
english.name: TOTHEEMBRASE

english.description: Finding and counting dead coffin robots is an interesting and extremely educational activity, although it's absolutely useless. If only there would be the living ones…
english.name: COFFINCOUNTER

english.description: If you press any broken button persistently, something will definitely happen. Maybe the button will break, or maybe even your finger.
english.name: PERSISTENT

english.description: Believing in yourself and never giving up, even when everything is useless and scripted, is breathtaking! No, you're breathtaking!
english.name: AWERSOME

english.description: Living coffins are no joke. Some may think that such a situation isn't a big deal, but in reality, a dead thing being alive makes it a zombie, a zombie is a bad thing, a bad thing is a problem, a problem is serious, serious equals an investigator and an investigator equals a life sentence. In the end, do you really want to go to prison?
english.name: COFFINKILLER

english.description: Properly disposing of synthetic animal corpses, you can save humanity from dangerous diseases and the fertile soil from senseless pollution. You can also enjoy magnificent gore effects but that's not what matters.
english.name: COWKILLER

english.description: Being the fastest is a real achievement! It's a real mastery! It deserves some respect! You hear, honey?! IT'S AN ACHIEVEMENT! =(
english.name: FASTSHOOTER

english.description: Shooting a machine gun is easy. Hitting a target with it is harder. It's even harder to hit a target with the shuttle's plasma guns when the shuttle isn't designed for them.
english.name: GUNMASTER

english.description: Being able to orientate yourself is an extremely important skill for any traveler. Don't forget to mark the landmarks that are visible from afar, keep an eye on the moss on tree trunks, and don't forget about the North star and your compass. Especially, if you're not in space.
english.name: MAP

english.description: One can listen to other people's advice forever, but it's much more valuable to think with your own head. You learn best from your own mistakes, as someone said... Or maybe they didn't.
english.name: OWNHEAD

english.description: Sometimes, among a thousand of options, only one is the right one. It's amazing how you managed to identify it. The greatest minds will break their heads over solving this puzzle.
english.name: RIGHTCHOISE

english.description: A man's palms say more than the backs of his hands, elbows, or navel. If you want to appear a strong and hard-working man in the eyes of others, you can rub your hands to get calluses that will brutally scratch other people's hands when you shake them.
english.name: TOUCHER

english.description: Spying on people is indecent, and spying on dead people is doubly indecent. Probably. The dictionary didn't say anything about it under the word "voyeur".
english.name: VUYAERIST

english.description: Not everyone can save the galaxy, but saving it by just sitting on the couch is beyond comprehension. Keep it up!
english.name: WASTED

english.description: They teach astronauts how to dock to airlocks even before teaching them how to use the space toilet. Missing the toilet is unpleasant, but not fatal — missing the airlock is a problem.
english.name: CONNECTION

english.description: With all due respect to the work of repair robots, they are useless competitors that consume resources. These guys are not subject to reprogramming and will fix everything that gets in their manipulators: shuttles, the liner's debris, vehicles, killer coffins…
english.name: ALLREPAIRS

english.description: It turns out that if you bomb a liner, the anti-asteroid turrets go crazy. They go crazy by themselves, without any killer coffins' help. That's right. In any case, space will be much safer without them.
english.name: ALLTURRETS

english.description: A quick and unexpected raid on the enemy's infrastructure is very effective, brave, and only a real space fighter is worthy of doing that. We can only hope that the coffins were really building these strange stations, and not destroying them.
english.name: COFFINBASE

english.description: Someone always has to control an army, even if it's an army of crazy coffins. A coffin squadron without a general is just a bunch of stupid meat containers, and a coffin squadron with a general is also just a bunch of stupid meat containers, but with a general. That's a fact!
english.name: COFFINGENERAL

english.description: It would be more correct to call this reward "An Ice-Shooter", but it sounds weird. In any case, the fewer unattended blocks of ice of questionable quality in space, the fewer people will be poisoned by poor-quality water in the future. Well, that's sanitary!
english.name: ICEBALLS

english.description: Either a very drunk, or a very meticulous pilot who wants to get a special achievement in his career would wipe all the asteroids in the area with a bottom of a space shuttle. It's up to you to decide, which one you want to be.
english.name: MANYCRASH

english.description: It's fun to shoot with a blaster, but to shoot with big military spaceship blasters is a lot more fun. However, there is some bad news and some good news. The bad news is that shooting military weapons is prohibited without a license. The good news is that everyone who could have inspected this has already died.
english.name: MANYSHOTS

english.description: A spring squeak, the smell of fresh engine oil, the noise of an angle grinder, and the fervent swearing of a mechanic — you can't find all this in outer space, and you never will. But what you can find is the creaking of your joints, the smell of fresh sweat, and the sound of blood in your ears. Space is a lousy place.
english.name: REPAIREMENT

schinese.description: 每位生还者都可谓当之无愧的奥斯卡奖得主。就这样办了。
schinese.name: ALIVE

schinese.description: 在棍子上插上一只永生不死的鸡，便成了导电性绝佳的电介质。现实生活中，不建议这样尝试，除非你有永生不死的鸡，你自己也永生不死。
schinese.name: CHICKENDIELECTRIC

schinese.description: 艺术家可能得罪任何人，也能画出所有人。通常二者是同时发生的。
schinese.name: PAINTER

schinese.description: 穿上内裤很暖和，要是多穿几条，冬天的时候都可以冬眠了！
schinese.name: SANDWICH

schinese.description: 只要你确定想让谁背锅，那么就没有你破不了的案件。
schinese.name: SHERLOCK

schinese.description: 在地球上，放屁是不雅的行为，不过在太空，关键时刻放个屁可使身体加速，拯救你的生命。
schinese.name: SMALLGASES

schinese.description: 你不受批评的影响。你最厉害。你的手所触碰和创造的一切都堪称神来之笔。这项成就独一无二，非你莫属。其他人得到的都是假的。
schinese.name: BUILDER

schinese.description: 拿别人的通行证用，就跟拿别人的学位证书用一样：可以连接到工程终端，吹嘘自己是个黑客，你要做的只是在显示器上点击“是”或“否”。
schinese.name: ENGINEER

schinese.description: 点燃燃气不仅会在一些网络论坛上引起轩然大波，还会将加速器的飞行速度提高20%。
schinese.name: FIREASS

schinese.description: 当你命悬一线，氧气只够吸一口，周围危险重重，死亡和痛苦笼罩着你时，飞越穿过所有巨型金属环！
schinese.name: AGILITY

schinese.description: 连续慢跑三天，做好了要参军的心理准备，吹嘘自己就要成为一名伞兵，突然，所有的医学测试都不达标，这算不算是“差点参军”？
schinese.name: SURVE

schinese.description: 吸尘器不仅可以快速打扫公寓，还可以像喷气式摩托车一样穿越时空。特别方便！
schinese.name: CLEANER

schinese.description: 劳动将猿变成了...肌肉更强健的猿。你拥有独特的破坏技能，现在你精湛的手艺，再加上这副便捷敲碎器，所碰之物尽皆造成更大损坏。
schinese.name: DESTROYER

schinese.description: “为了一己私利而破坏整个垃圾收集基础设施，真是罪大恶极，”我母亲是这样说的。不过谁在乎呢？远处不就是一台清洁机器人吗？
schinese.name: DIRTY

schinese.description: 到处乱飞的死人是没机会对你那部崭新的ZAZ靓车惊呼了，不过开车兜兜风感觉还是很不错的...没风也没关系...
schinese.name: DRIVER

schinese.description: 总鼓捣电，你可能会对电免疫。可能性比较大，但最好不要尝试。
schinese.name: ELECTRONIC

schinese.description: 完成第二章的难度几乎和完成第三章一样大。情况就是这样。
schinese.name: END2CHAPTER

schinese.description: 完成第三章的难度几乎和完成第二章一样大。情况就是这样。
schinese.name: END3CHAPTER

schinese.description: 然是关于控制面板，那就没问题，你可以继续打开棺材。
schinese.name: HAKER

schinese.description: 恭喜！如果你没有作弊，那你就是在推动这个行业的发展！在某种意义上吧，但不一定就是积极的意义。
schinese.name: INDUSTRIALHELPER

schinese.description: 扫描基因工程死去的产物有助于太空服补充其无用的图片库。如果需要的话，也许可以把这些图片卖给报社。
schinese.name: MUTAGEN

schinese.description: 根据太空服的颜色很容易便可以判断出一个人的精神障碍。如果你是个骗子就更容易了。真正的专业精神病医生会想法找出然后添加上这种疾病的所有其他可能的症状。
schinese.name: PSYCHO

schinese.description: 当你命悬一线，氧气只够吸一口，周围危险重重，死亡和痛苦笼罩着你时，飞越穿过所有巨型金属环！
schinese.name: REBELIOUS

schinese.description: 看起来射击一两百发子弹并没有什么难度，不过如果每发子弹的代价是整个空间站，那就彻底要另当别论了。
schinese.name: RIFLEMAN

schinese.description: 攻击安保机器人是重罪，即便没有人看到你的作案过程。不过反过来看呢，还是重罪，总之这样做没有什么好处。
schinese.name: ROUGE

schinese.description: 在太空养奶牛实属易事：把它们堆成一堆，然后等待救援人员的到来，在这之前不要碰它们就行了。
schinese.name: SHEPHERD

schinese.description: 没必要挺身而上，用你的胸膛掩护一管射线武器。你要是乐意，倒也没什么不可以，不过在这种情况下，确实没有什么必要。如果你真想这样做，别忘了先关掉武器。
schinese.name: TOTHEEMBRASE

schinese.description: 寻找并计算死去的棺材机器人是一项有趣且极具教育意义的活动，不过这毫无用处。要是有活着 的棺材机器人就好了...
schinese.name: COFFINCOUNTER

schinese.description: 如果你持续地按任何损坏的按钮，肯定会有事发生。也许按钮会断，又或许你的手指会断。
schinese.name: PERSISTENT

schinese.description: 相信自己，永不放弃，即使一切都是无用的，即使剧本早已写好——这样做多么令人惊叹！ 不，令人惊叹的是你！
schinese.name: AWERSOME

schinese.description: 活棺材可不是闹着玩的。 有些人可能觉得，这种情况没什么大不了的。但实际的情况是，死的东西活了过来就变成了僵尸，僵尸是一个不好的东西，出现不好的东西代表出现了问题，出现问题是严重的情况，出现严重的情况意味着调查者必须出动，调查员的出动等同于终身监禁。 最后，你真的希望锒铛入狱吗？
schinese.name: COFFINKILLER

schinese.description: 正确处置人造动物尸体，让人类免受疾病的威胁，让肥沃的土壤免受无谓的污染。 你还可以享受到令人兴奋的血腥效果，但这不是最重要的。
schinese.name: COWKILLER

schinese.description: 成为最快的玩家是一个实实在在的成就！ 这代表了你高超的水准！ 值得尊敬！ 你听到了吗，亲爱的？！ 这真的是一个成就！=(
schinese.name: FASTSHOOTER

schinese.description: 用机关枪射击很容易。 但射中目标可没那么容易。 使用穿梭机的等离子枪射中目标更是难上加难，因为穿梭机并不是为等离子枪设计的。
schinese.name: GUNMASTER

schinese.description: 对于所有旅行者来说，能够为自己定位是一项极其重要的技能。 别忘了标出远处的地标，留意树干上的苔藓，观察北极星和你的罗盘。 尤其是你不在太空中的时候。
schinese.name: MAP

schinese.description: 一个人可以永远听从他人的建议，但用自己的头脑思考远比这更有价值。 正如某人说的，自己的错误是最好的老师…… 又或许并没有人这么说过。
schinese.name: OWNHEAD

schinese.description: 有时候，在一千个选项中，只有一个是正确的。 你成功地辨认出了正确的选择，太神奇了。 连最伟大的智者也会为解决这个难题而绞尽脑汁。
schinese.name: RIGHTCHOISE

schinese.description: 男人的手心比手背、手肘或肚脐更能说明问题。 如果你希望在他人眼中表现得强壮而勤劳，你只需摩擦手掌，直到让手掌长出老茧。这样一来，在和别人握手的时候，你就可以用粗糙的老茧摩擦他们的手掌了。
schinese.name: TOUCHER

schinese.description: 窥探他人不是体面的行为，窥探死者更是不雅。 应该如此。 字典的“窥探者”词条下并没有说什么。
schinese.name: VUYAERIST

schinese.description: 不是所有人都能拯救银河系，但让人难以理解的是，只需要靠坐在沙发上就能拯救它。 再接再厉！
schinese.name: WASTED

schinese.description: 宇航员甚至在学习如何使用太空厕所之前，就已经学会了如何对接气闸。没有厕所固然让人难受，但却不是致命的——没有气闸才是大麻烦。
schinese.name: CONNECTION

schinese.description: 恕我直言，修理机器人是单纯消耗资源的竞争对手。这些家伙不会被更新编程，它们会修理所有落入它们操纵臂的东西：穿梭机、航天班机碎片、载具、杀手棺材……
schinese.name: ALLREPAIRS

schinese.description: 事实证明，如果你炸了一艘航天班机，反小行星炮塔就会失控。它们是自己失控的，杀手棺材并没有动什么手脚。就是这样的。不管怎么说，没有它们，太空将会更加安全。
schinese.name: ALLTURRETS

schinese.description: 对敌人的基础设施进行快速的突然袭击是非常有效且勇敢的，只有真正的太空斗士才配得上这样的行为。我们只能希望这些棺材真的是在建造这些奇奇怪怪的站点，而不是在摧毁它们。
schinese.name: COFFINBASE

schinese.description: 军队总得有一个主帅，即使是一支疯狂的棺材军队。一支没有主帅的棺材中队只是一堆愚蠢的肉体容器，一支有了主帅的棺材中队也只是一堆有主帅的愚蠢的肉体容器。这就是事实！
schinese.name: COFFINGENERAL

schinese.description: 将这个奖励称为“冰上射击者”会更加正确，但这个名字听起来怪怪的。无论如何，太空中无人处理的劣质冰块越少，将来受劣质水源毒害的人就越少。这就是公共卫生！
schinese.name: ICEBALLS

schinese.description: 只有酩酊大醉的飞行员，或一心希望在职业生涯中取得特殊成就的飞行员才会驾驶太空穿梭机摧毁这一地区内的所有小行星。你是哪一种，你自己来决定。
schinese.name: MANYCRASH

schinese.description: 用爆破枪射击是一件很有趣的事，用大型军用飞船爆破枪射击更是妙趣横生。然而，关于这件事，有一个坏消息和一个好消息要告诉你。坏消息是，无证使用军用武器射击是被禁止的；好消息是，所有能进行检查的人都已经死了。
schinese.name: MANYSHOTS

schinese.description: 弹簧的吱吱声、新鲜机油的气味、角磨机的噪声以及机械师热切的咒骂声——外太空中不存在这些东西，也永远不会存在。你能感受的是关节的咯吱声、新鲜汗液的味道以及耳朵里血液的涌动声。太空真是糟透了。
schinese.name: REPAIREMENT
